For web advertisers, install the AppLovin Pixel through the Shopify App Store or Google Tag Manager. For app advertisers, integrate your MMP. Then set up your campaign and define your goal and budget. Upload your existing creative assets and use AppLovin’s AI ad generation tools to build additional assets. Once you launch, AppLovin Ads automatically targets the right users and optimizes toward your goal.What budget do I need to get started?expand_moreYou can launch on AppLovin Ads with a budget as low as $10/day. Launch campaigns with a budget that fits your business and scale as you see results.Can I use the creatives I'm already running elsewhere?expand_moreYes. You can upload your existing creative assets, including videos and images, into creative sets on AppLovin Ads.For best results, we recommend uploading as many creatives as possible.
